Beds are the tenants’ own: dashed queen-to-king mattress

ST-R04-NS01, ST-R04-NS02, ST-R05-NS01); tenants may use movable
tables. Room and bed positions are unchanged.
R05 SITE-CHECK PINCH (HD-15): approximately 387.6 mm at the
bed-foot/study-return, not a comfortable walking route. Keep room
and furniture positions unchanged. Measure the tenant bed frame,
fixed return and unobstructed route on site (OI-R05-03).
